notes: Sole implementor context is RequestGate (a concurrency/rate-limit gate guarding a bounded number of outstanding requests via anInt3298). RequestGate.method1947(i, disposable) calls disposable.w(false) immediately when the request can proceed right away (i >= anInt3298, i.e. under the current limit), or otherwise wraps it in a DisposableHolder and enqueues it in a NodeDeque to be released later; RequestGate.method1948 drains that queue and calls disposable.w(true) on each queued item once capacity frees up. So the Boolean conveys whether the callback fired immediately (false) or only after waiting in the queue (true) - a completion/ready callback, not really a resource-dispose signal despite the interface name. Kept 'Disposable' interface name unchanged per instructions (class names out of scope); recommend method name reflects the observed semantics.
